Bígí ag Ceol is a music series for children presented by Cian Ó Griallais. Every episode focuses on a new song written in Irish for children. The songs will be written by Cian, the children on the show and our special guest from the BÍGÍ AG CEOL band. On this episode we write a song about the zoo.

st: Curious George Takes a Job; Curious George Takes Another Job
d: George goes to chef Pisghetti's restaurant and experiments with cooking things, helped by Gnocchi the cat, while the chef himself prepares a meal for a restaurant critic. After his success helping chef Pisghetti impress the restaurant critic, the chef suggests that George helps Mr Glass wash the windows of the Glass Palace skyscraper.

The Doobydoos are making hats for Boris and Sandy. Uncle Charlie is hoping to get the bouncy castle up and running, but the question is whether Tommy will be allowed on it.
Sibéal has lots of fun today getting ready for Easter.
